desc:
Welcome to Drive a Bed Downhill🛏️

Hop in a bed and send it down the mountain! Weave through forests, farms, canyons and city traffic, take risky shortcuts, hop obstacles, and try not to fly off the edge.

Race with or against your friends downhill to see who drives the bed best!

Ride down multiple times to get a faster time.

CONTROLS

💻 PC
W - Gas
A / D - Steer
S - Brake
Space - Hop
E - Boost
Shift - Drift
F - Reset to Road
C - Camera

📱 MOBILE
Left / Right - Steer
Gas Button - Gas
Brake Button - Brake
Hop Button - Hop
Boost Button - Boost
Double Tap + Hold Brake - Drift

🎮 CONTROLLER
Left Stick - Steer
RT / R2 - Gas
LT / L2 - Brake
A / Cross - Hop
RB / R1 - Boost
LB / L1 - Drift
B / Circle - Reset to Road

👍 Like, favorite and join the group for new beds, worlds and updates!
